approved_payload.content: A man was stabbed to death along Strandbrook in Brookdale, Phoenix, on the afternoon of Wednesday 28 October. According to KZN VIP Security, he was on his way to a local tuck shop when he got into a confrontation with three men, who allegedly assaulted him with various weapons and stabbed him several times; he was declared dead at the scene. KZN VIP Security, SAPS and other emergency services responded. KZN VIP spokesperson Gareth Naidoo said the circumstances, the motive and the identities of those involved had not been confirmed. This account comes from a private security company: no police statement was found, and SAPS has not confirmed a case. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. Sources: Phoenix Tabloid, 29 October; Accidents.co.za, 29 October (the security company's statement). The map point is approximate: the pin is Strandbrook Crescent in Brookdale, the only Strandbrook found on the map there.
